title: 第16章硬刚唐昊，融合祖龙血脉-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “快起来，别在这里装晕。”

    叶寒生怕唐昊再次动手，将小舞推开，站起身来。

    小舞则是捂着胸口，摇摇晃晃地站了起来。

    就在刚才，她的胸前遭受重击，差点没让她喘过气来。

    “叶寒，小舞？”

    “你们怎么在这！”

    被揍得鼻青脸肿的赵无极，看到俩人，惊喊一声，不顾疼痛和伤势，纵身跳到俩人身前，将他们拦在身后。

    此时，唐昊也看到了叶寒和小舞，收回了昊天锤。

    对于小舞这只十万年魂兽，他很熟悉。

    这些年来，他一直都在暗中保护唐三。

    早在唐三跟小舞于诺丁城初级学院相遇时，他就看出了小舞的真实身份。

    之所以没有出来阻止，一是唐三的母亲阿银，也是一只化形为人的十万年魂兽，二是想让小舞跟唐三建立亲密关系，把小舞圈养在唐三身边，等唐三有需要时，再将其杀了。

    对于叶寒，他也有所了解。

    昨天唐三与叶寒之间的交手情况，他可是看在眼里，还算是有点能耐。

    在他眼中，小舞是魂环和魂骨，叶寒是唐三最好的踏脚石。

    “老赵，他们是？”

    弗兰德好奇地走了过来。

    以他对赵无极的了解，眼前突然出现的俩人，极有可能是史莱克学院今天刚招的新生。

    “院长，他们都是我们史莱克学院这届新招的学生。”

    “尤其是这位少年，实力很强，是我见过资质最强的。”

    赵无极见弗兰德询问起来，在他的耳边小声回复。

    虽然他的声音很小，但还是被唐昊听在耳中，听得他很不高兴。

    在他眼里，他的儿子唐三才是斗罗大陆最优秀的天才。

    毕竟可不是谁都能拥有双生武魂。

    “赵无极，别以为本座听不到。”

    “难道我儿子唐三，资质就不是最强的吗？”

    唐昊怒声叱喝，恨不得再揍他一顿。

    当着他的面，夸别人的孩子优秀，这是在打他的脸。

    小舞听闻，表情微微一愣。

    他是唐三的父亲？

    怎么可能。

    唐三不是说他的父亲只是一个普通铁匠吗？

    怎么会是封号斗罗。

    如果这都是真的，或许她不会有生命危险。

    以她跟唐三的关系，唐昊应该不会故意为难她吧。

    叶寒倒是没有多大的反应，也就是有点小小的震惊。

    据系统给的信息了解，封号斗罗是这个世界的顶级战力，是万中无一的存在，更是所有魂师都梦寐以求的境界。

    想要拥有封号斗罗的实力，不但需要惊人的天赋，还需要努力和机遇。

    而成为封号斗罗就是他前期奋斗的小目标。

    只有成为封号斗罗，他才能拥有足够的自保能力。

    “昊天冕下，您说的是。”

    “唐三是我们史莱克学院最优秀的天才，不，应该是斗罗大陆最优秀的天才。”

    赵无极见唐昊听到了，连忙改口。

    他可不想挨揍了。

    “哼，这还差不多。”

    “小子，听说你的资质很不错，我在你的身上也能感知到浓郁的杀气。”

    “倒不如，让我来试试你的潜力。”

    唐昊身为斗罗大陆仅存的三大杀神之一，对杀气拥有极强的感知力。

    他能感知到，叶寒体内的杀气不一般，已经凝练到了极致。

    如此年纪，便能做到这一点，实属不易。

    他怀疑叶寒有可能来自杀戮之都。
    第(1/3)页

"Get up quickly, don't pretend to be fainted here."

Ye Han was afraid that Tang Hao would strike again, so he pushed Xiao Wu away and stood up.

Xiao Wu covered her chest and stood up unsteadily.

Just now, she suffered a heavy blow to her chest that almost stopped her from breathing.

"Ye Han, Xiao Wu?"

"Why are you here!"

Zhao Wuji, who was beaten until his nose was bruised and his face was swollen, screamed when he saw the two people. Regardless of the pain and injuries, he jumped in front of the two people and stopped them behind him.

At this time, Tang Hao also saw Ye Han and Xiao Wu and took back the Clear Sky Hammer.

He is very familiar with Xiao Wu, a hundred thousand year old soul beast.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​He has been secretly protecting Tang San.

As early as when Tang San and Xiao Wu met at Notting City Junior College, he saw Xiao Wu's true identity.

The reason why he didn't come out to stop him was that Tang San's mother A Yin was also a hundred thousand year old soul beast that took the form of a human. The second reason was that he wanted Xiao Wu to establish a close relationship with Tang San, so he kept Xiao Wu close to Tang San, and then killed him when Tang San needed it.

He also knew something about Ye Han.

He had seen the fight between Tang San and Ye Han yesterday, and he was somewhat capable.

In his eyes, Xiao Wu is the soul ring and soul bone, and Ye Han is Tang San's best stepping stone.

"Old Zhao, who are they?"

Flanders came over curiously.

Based on his understanding of Zhao Wuji, the two people who suddenly appeared in front of him were most likely the freshmen recruited by Shrek Academy today.

"Dean, they are all newly recruited students of our Shrek Academy."

“Especially this young man, he is very strong and the most qualified person I have ever seen.”

When Zhao Wuji saw Flanders asking, he whispered a reply in his ear.

Although his voice was very small, it was still heard by Tang Hao, which made him very unhappy.

In his eyes, his son Tang San is the best genius in Douluo Continent.

After all, not everyone can have twin martial spirits.

"Zhao Wuji, don't think that I can't hear you."

“Isn’t my son Tang San’s aptitude the strongest?”

Tang Hao shouted angrily, wanting to beat him again.

In front of him, praising other people's children for their excellence is a slap in his face.

When Xiao Wu heard this, his expression was slightly startled.

He is Tang San’s father?

How is that possible.

Didn’t Tang San say that his father was just an ordinary blacksmith?

How could he be a titled Douluo?

If this is true, maybe her life will not be in danger.

Based on her relationship with Tang San, Tang Hao probably wouldn't deliberately embarrass her.

Ye Han didn't have much reaction, just a little shocked.

According to the information provided by the system, Titled Douluo is the top combat power in this world, a unique existence among ten thousand, and a realm that all soul masters dream of.

“ To have the strength of a titled Douluo requires not only amazing talent, but also hard work and opportunities.

And becoming a titled Douluo was his small goal in the early stage.

Only by becoming a titled Douluo can he have sufficient self-protection ability.

"Your Majesty Haotian, you are right."

"Tang San is the best genius in our Shrek Academy, no, he should be the best genius in Douluo Continent."

Zhao Wuji saw that Tang Hao had heard it and quickly changed his words.

He doesn’t want to get beaten.

"Huh, that's pretty much it."

"Boy, I heard that your qualifications are very good. I can also feel the strong murderous aura in you."

“It’s better to let me test your potential.”

As one of the only three remaining gods of murder in Douluo Continent, Tang Hao has a strong sense of murderous intent.

He could sense that the murderous aura in Ye Han's body was extraordinary and had been condensed to the extreme.

It is not easy to be able to do this at such an age.

He suspected that Ye Han might come from the Killing City.

title_en: Chapter 16: Fight against Tang Hao and merge with the bloodline of the ancestral dragon - "Douluo V: Bind Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning and create a god-level family"
